title: The Bladders That Split in Four
story: In the flooded sea-cave of Low Lantern, Gorrowkelp the Quartering Bladderweed floats as 3 fat glowing bladders, pinning a crab-fisher's raft to the ceiling. Mr 6 learns the nasty rule: every single time anything strikes it, each bladder bursts into 4 new bladders. He counts on his fingers before he even thinks about swinging.
question: If Mr 6 struck Gorrowkelp 4 times, each strike turning every bladder into 4 bladders, how many bladders would be floating in the cave?
solution: Each strike multiplies the count by 4, starting from 3 bladders.
That would be 768 bladders - so Mr 6 wisely keeps his sword sheathed.
praise: Multiplying by 4 each strike was exactly right - it just needed one more round of 4 to cover all four strikes.
hint: Write the count after each strike in a little chain: start at 3, then multiply by 4 once for every strike.
victory: Mr 6 sheathes his sword, politely tickles the raft loose with his cape instead, and Gorrowkelp - never struck, never split - burbles a confused thank-you.
imagePrompt: Glowing green kelp bladders bobbing against a dripping sea-cave ceiling above a trapped little raft, with a numeral-six knight thoughtfully NOT swinging his sword, eerie underwater light.
